content: {"summary":"Customers report that Xbox One X struggles with HDR and 4K playback, citing issues such as the console not recognizing HDR on 1080p monitors and failing to display 4K 10‑bit color simultaneously [tk_1465811][tk_556853]. Many users also complain that Blu‑ray apps either show letterboxed video or lack aspect‑ratio controls, and that Blu‑ray artwork disappears or appears low‑resolution on the home screen [tk_2858568][tk_2276688]. Additionally, some owners cannot output 4K @60Hz due to HDMI 2.0 limitations and are unsure whether a future HDMI 2.1 update will resolve this [tk_2232757][tk_2420250]. These problems highlight a need for firmware fixes and clearer hardware‑compatibility guidance from Microsoft and OEMs. "}
